title: The Free Lift — Episode 1: Final Master Voice Sync

lines.text: Har hospital ke blueprint par... sirf barah floors likhe hain.
Lekin is peetal ki lift ke andar... terah buttons hain.
Par kya aapko pata hai... ye aakhir kiske liye rukti hai?
Ninyanve raat tak, Maya ne khaali corridors shoot kiye... bhooton ko jhootha saabit karne.
Sirf dhool. Zero views. Koi bhoot pret nahi.
Phir ek leaked nurse comment ne usey Wing B bheja... theek do saintalis AM par.
Band lobby ke andar, usey watchman ke teen purane rules... likhe mile.
Rule number ek... khule morgue darwaze ke andar... kabhi mat jana.
Rule number do... agar lift apne aap chale... to sheeshe mein mat dekhna.
Rule number teen... Floor terah 1978 se sealed hai. Speaker tumhara naam le... to jawab mat dena.
Basement hallway mein... barfeeli hawa... teen inch khule morgue door se aa rahi thi.
Night one hundred... wait, ye morgue door khula hua kyun hai?
Maya paas gayi... aur usne woh thanda peetal ka handle... kheench liya.
Uska phone ek baar jhapka. Sirf ek percent bacha tha.
Tabhi achanak... bilkul ghana... andhera.
Hello? Koi hai yahan?
Peeche peetal ki lift khud khul gayi. Woh andar gayi... aur lohe ke darwaze zor se band ho gaye.
Floor ek... floor paanch... floor baarah. Phir usne upar dekha... us sheeshe mein...
Aur sunn reh gayi. Sheeshe ke andar... poori lift... bilkul khaali thi.
Ruko, main kahan hoon?! Main khud ko dekh kyun nahi paa rahi?!
lines.caps: *MAIN KAHAN HOON?! | khud ko *dekh kyun nahi rahi?!

lines.text: Maya Chen. You were never supposed to find this. Welcome to Floor thirteen.
Darwaze andhere mein khule... beech mein purana mailbox, uski khud ki file... stamped dead 1978.
lines.caps: MAILBOX MEIN | USKI APNI FILE... | STAMPED *DECEASED 1978.

lines.text: Ab woh... tumhari hui.
Yeh... yeh mere haathon ko kya ho raha hai?!
lines.caps: MERE HAATHON KO | *KYA HO RAHA HAI?!

lines.text: Peeche sheeshe mein... do kaali khokhli aankhein muskura rahi thin... woh Maya nahi thi.
lines.caps: *KHOKHLI AANKHEIN | MUSKURA RAHI THIN. | WOH *MAYA NAHI THI.

lines.text: Agar aap Floor terah par phanse hote... to Exit doors ki taraf bhaagte, ya chamakta Keycard uthaate?
Abhi comment mein A ya B likho. Follow karo... Part Two aap likhoge.
